note: Rustic Superior NF campground on the Poplar River beside the FR 164 (Honeymoon Trail) bridge, between the Sawbill and Caribou Trails above Tofte and Lutsen; trout fishing from the camp, no garbage pickup. Room for one vehicle and one towed vehicle per site; no posted RV length. --Claude
summary: FS page read: free, first-come, vault toilet, no water, May 8 - Oct 1 (off season now, 'Closed-No fees or services'). Imagery shows about four spur clearings and a stream 6-10 m wide: riverfront -> creekside on width. Note cleaned.
flags: WATERFRONT riverfront -> creekside (size rule): at the campground the Poplar River measures about 6-10 m wide on Esri z19 imagery, well under 30 m. The westmost clearing (~47.7384,-90.7779, sites unnumbered) sits ~12-20 m from the stream over grass with scattered trees and shrubs, matching FS 'Several of the sites have access directly to the river' / 'The campground fronts the Poplar River'. The other clearings are farther back under conifer cover. If the reviewer judges that fringe canopy, the value would fall to not waterfront (there is no creek-view value).

STATUS: page banner 'Closed-No fees or services' is the post-October 1 off season ('Seasons of Use May 8 - October 1'), not a closure. The forest-wide 'Post Wildfire Closures, Effective October 1, 2026' alert was not shown as covering this site.
SITES: count 4 (derived) consistent with about four spur clearings on imagery; FS posts no count and no max length. Restriction 'space for one vehicle and one towed vehicle'.
